column3: [annoyed] Ugh! Can you stop shaking the whole couch?!
[deadpan] Gotcha. I'm a one-way door. Up only.
Yo, Calf! We need a lift up to the heart!
[lazy] Can't. I only pump when he moves.
[worried] But it's getting so crowded down here!
[confused] Wait... why is the floor shaking?
[excited] He's bouncing his leg! That's my cue!
[smug] That's why they call me the second heart.
Doc, everyone says stop bouncing my leg. Is it bad?
Not for your blood flow. Each calf squeeze pushes blood up your veins, back to your heart.
One-way valves keep it from sliding back down.
In a small study, people sat for three hours. Blood flow dropped in the still leg and rose in the fidgeting one.
But the best fix is simple. Get up and walk.
